headline: Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel is scheduled to begin a two-day visit to Pakistan on Sunday for talks with Ishaq Dar on expanding trade and investment, Pakistan's Foreign Ministry said, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Pakistan-Portugal trade reached $288 million in fiscal 2025

caption:
Portugal's Foreign Minister begins a two-day visit to Pakistan today! 🇵🇰🇵🇹
According to Arab News, Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel is scheduled to begin a two-day visit to Pakistan on Sunday, at the invitation of Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, for talks on expanding trade and investment. Pakistan's Foreign Ministry said the talks will cover agriculture, including olive cultivation, renewable energy, maritime connectivity, migration and education. Bilateral trade reached $288 million in fiscal 2025, up from $189 million in 2020, and a Pakistan-Portugal Business Forum is set for Monday.
